the dynamic nature of the smart home environment and the complexity of the smart home architecture pose significant challenges in identifying and monitoring risks.

the existing dynamic risk assessment models are not applicable in the smart home context due to the dynamic nature of the environment and that the existing static risk assessment models cannot be applied to a smart home context due either due to their lack of dynamic features or due to their inability to capture the dynamic operational aspects of a smart home.
